parameters.opportunity_thesis: Product ownership of clinical reference data and terminology services.
excluded_conditions: on site five days a week

postings.title: Clinical Data Product Owner
postings.body:
Northwind builds reference data services for clinical trial teams.

You will own the roadmap for our terminology and master data products, run backlog and sprint planning for a squad of six engineers, and define canonical records and entity resolution rules with data stewards.

What you bring: two or more years as a product owner for data products, working knowledge of clinical terminologies such as MedDRA, and experience with data governance workflows.

This role is remote within Canada.

postings.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
postings.body:
Globex is hiring a senior frontend engineer to build our customer dashboard in React and TypeScript.

You will own component architecture, accessibility, and performance budgets for the web application, and pair with designers on the design system.

What you bring: five or more years of professional React development and deep CSS knowledge.

This role is on site in our Toronto office five days a week.
